name: training-material-designer
description: Design AI literacy training material for non-technical audiences including operators, managers, procurement staff, legal, and HR. Distinct from lecture-designer (which targets CS students) — this is for organisational capability building. Covers: what AI can and cannot do, how to work with AI systems, how to evaluate AI outputs, and how to make AI-related decisions. Triggers on: "design a training for", "create AI literacy material", "build a workshop on AI for", "help non-technical staff understand AI", "training programme for", "onboarding material on AI", "how to explain AI to managers", "AI awareness training".
